sentences.zh: 伙计们，今天我们要聊的是《激励》这一集。

sentences.en: It was written by Paul Lieberstein and directed by Charles McDougal.
sentences.zh: 由保罗·李伯斯坦编剧，查尔斯·麦克道格执导。

sentences.en: Here is your summary.
sentences.zh: 这是剧情梗概。

sentences.en: Robert California tells Andy he wants the Scranton branch to double their sales.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·加州告诉安迪，他希望斯克兰顿分公司能将销售额翻倍。

sentences.en: So Andy introduces a Points for Prizes reward program to incentivize these doubling of sales,
sentences.zh: 于是安迪推出了一个“积分换奖品”的奖励计划来激励大家实现销售翻倍，

sentences.en: but it kind of soon blows up in his face.
sentences.zh: 但很快这事儿就让他自食其果了。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Pam and Angela become pregnant walking buddies.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，帕姆和安吉拉成了怀孕期间的步行搭子。

sentences.en: So short-lived.
sentences.zh: 真是太短暂了。

sentences.en: Like the shortest walking buddies ever.
sentences.zh: 简直是有史以来最短命的步行搭子。

sentences.en: Fast fact number one is all about the making of the Saber Pyramid.
sentences.zh: 第一个冷知识是关于“赛博金字塔”的制作过程。

sentences.en: Dwight is going to introduce this new electronic tablet in the shape of a pyramid that Saber wants them to sell.
sentences.zh: 德怀特要介绍这款Saber公司想让他们销售的、金字塔形状的新型电子平板电脑。

sentences.en: It is very large and it doesn't do much.
sentences.zh: 它非常大，而且功能不多。

sentences.en: Well, you know, Jenna, without the battery or optional memory booster, it's barely three pounds.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，珍娜，如果不加电池或可选的内存增强器，它也就三磅重。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: But if you need a battery or optional memory, what is it?
sentences.zh: 但如果加上电池或可选内存，它得有多重？

sentences.en: Like 10 pounds?
sentences.zh: 得有10磅吧？

sentences.en: How heavy is this thing?
sentences.zh: 这玩意儿到底有多重？

sentences.en: Also, it's got 50L of memory.
sentences.zh: 而且，它只有50升的内存。

sentences.en: Yeah, you're going to want the booster.
sentences.zh: 是啊，你肯定会想要那个增强器的。

sentences.en: We had a fan question from Cameron C.
sentences.zh: 我们收到一个来自加州卡梅伦·C的粉丝提问。

sentences.en: in California who wanted to know how functional was the Saber Pyramid.
sentences.zh: 他想知道Saber金字塔到底有多实用。

sentences.en: It looks like it might be a non-functional computer screen that you just turn on and off since nobody seems to really use it during the show.
sentences.zh: 看起来它可能只是个非功能性的电脑屏幕，你只能把它开关一下，因为在节目里似乎没人真正用过它。

sentences.en: Also, how did they make them?
sentences.zh: 另外，他们是怎么制作这些东西的？

sentences.en: It seems like a pretty specialized job to cut a screen into a triangle shape.
sentences.zh: 把屏幕切割成三角形似乎是一项相当专业的工作。

sentences.en: Well, guess who I talked to this morning.
sentences.zh: 嗯，猜猜我今天早上和谁聊了天。

sentences.en: Please say Phil Shea.
sentences.zh: 请说是菲尔·谢伊。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 拜托了。

sentences.en: Phil Shea.
sentences.zh: 菲尔·谢伊。

sentences.en: Woo-hoo!
sentences.zh: 呜呼！

sentences.en: Just the loveliest man of all time.
sentences.zh: 他简直是有史以来最可爱的人。

sentences.en: He just finished doing a pilot for Justin Spitzer.
sentences.zh: 他刚为贾斯汀·斯皮策做完一部试播集。

sentences.en: And he mentioned that he ran into you in Bed, Bath & Beyond with the blankets.
sentences.zh: 他还提到在“家居乐”超市看到你带着毯子。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He had every shade of gray you could buy.
sentences.zh: 他买了你能买到的所有灰色调的毯子。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Apparently, someone in this pilot has a gray-themed bedroom.
sentences.zh: 显然，这部试播集里的某个人有个灰色主题的卧室。

sentences.en: Well, Phil told me that the Saber Pyramid was Paul Lieberstein's idea.
sentences.zh: 嗯，菲尔告诉我，Saber金字塔是保罗·利伯斯坦的主意。

sentences.en: It was going to be a parody of those new tablet computers that were just coming out onto the market at the time of this episode, specifically the Apple iPad.
sentences.zh: 它原本是想恶搞当时刚上市的新型平板电脑，特别是苹果iPad。

sentences.en: And in the script, all it said was this, quote,
sentences.zh: 剧本里只写了这么一句，引用如下：

sentences.en: Dwight holds up the tablet.
sentences.zh: 德怀特举起平板电脑。

sentences.en: It is triangle-shaped.
sentences.zh: 它是三角形的。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Those were the only details.
sentences.zh: 只有这些细节。

sentences.en: So Phil said that they started by making a bunch of drawings, which they got Paul's approval on.
sentences.zh: 所以菲尔说，他们先画了一堆草图，并得到了保罗的批准。

sentences.en: And then once they had that, they went to this place called Studio Art and Technology.
sentences.zh: 一旦确定了方案，他们就去了那家叫“艺术与技术工作室”的地方。

sentences.en: And these guys did, like, a real kind of engineering design of it.
sentences.zh: 这些人对它进行了真正的工程设计。

sentences.en: And if you can believe it, they printed the case using a 3D printer.
sentences.zh: 你敢信吗，他们是用3D打印机打印的外壳。

sentences.en: That's so cool.
sentences.zh: 太酷了。

sentences.en: Isn't that amazing?
sentences.zh: 这不是很神奇吗？

sentences.en: And he said they covered it in plexiglass.
sentences.zh: 他说他们用有机玻璃覆盖了它。

sentences.en: And they did have one that was functional that actually turned on and lit up.
sentences.zh: 他们确实有一个能用的，可以开机并点亮。

sentences.en: They even had the capability of different graphics to kind of switch from different screens.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至有能力切换不同的图形，实现不同屏幕间的转换。

sentences.en: But any of that that you see, that was CGI that was done in poSt.
sentences.zh: 但你看到的任何画面，都是后期制作的CGI。

sentences.en: It was not, like, fully functional.
sentences.zh: 它并不是完全可用的。

sentences.en: It could turn on and show the Saber logo.
sentences.zh: 它能开机并显示Saber的标志。

sentences.en: And then anything else basically was CGI movement on that screen.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，屏幕上的其他任何东西基本都是CGI动画。

sentences.en: Phil said they made two of these light-up pyramids because there's a famous saying in the props world, which is, when you have one, you have none.
sentences.zh: 菲尔说他们做了两个这种能发光的金字塔，因为道具界有句名言：当你只有一个的时候，就等于没有。

sentences.en: Because one means something's going to happen to it, and then you have nothing.
sentences.zh: 因为只有一个的话，万一出点什么事，你就什么都没有了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: When you have one, you have none.
sentences.zh: 拥有一个就等于没有。

sentences.en: I kind of like that.
sentences.zh: 我挺喜欢这句话的。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, anyway, he said later, when we get to some later episodes, you're going to see more of these.
sentences.zh: 总之，他说以后，等我们聊到后面的剧集时，你们会看到更多这些东西。

sentences.en: And he gave me the detail about those, too.
sentences.zh: 他还给了我关于那些东西的细节。

sentences.en: But I'll save it.
sentences.zh: 但我先卖个关子。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Why tell you now?
sentences.zh: 为什么要现在告诉你呢？

sentences.en: Save it.
sentences.zh: 留着以后说。

sentences.en: Because I have a few tech websites that had their own review of the Saber Pyramid.
sentences.zh: 因为我有几个科技网站，它们对“军刀金字塔”有自己的评价。

sentences.en: Oh, really?
sentences.zh: 哦，真的吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Not everyone wanted to unleash the power of the pyramid.
sentences.zh: 并不是每个人都想释放金字塔的力量。

sentences.en: You know, Angela, when I was talking to Phil, he told me a really cool story about James Spader.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，你知道吗，我和菲尔聊天时，他跟我讲了一个关于詹姆斯·斯派德的很酷的故事。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah?
sentences.zh: 哦，是吗？

sentences.en: First of all, he loved working with James, adored him.
sentences.zh: 首先，他非常喜欢和詹姆斯合作，简直崇拜他。

sentences.en: He said he was, like, such a serious actor and so kind and appreciative with everyone.
sentences.zh: 他说詹姆斯是一位非常严肃的演员，对每个人都非常友善且懂得感恩。

sentences.en: And he said, you know, for the episode, The List, when Robert California says, I never use a pen, that he only writes in pencil.
sentences.zh: 他说，在《名单》那一集里，当罗伯特·加州说“我从不用钢笔，只用铅笔书写”时。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: He said that James Spader came up to him and said, Phil, could I please get an assortment of different mechanical pencils so that I can choose the exact right one?
sentences.zh: 他说詹姆斯·斯派德走过来对他说：“菲尔，能帮我找各种不同的自动铅笔吗？这样我才能选出最合适的那一支。”

sentences.en: Because he believed his character had an attachment to, like, a particular mechanical pencil.
sentences.zh: 因为他认为他的角色对某一种特定的自动铅笔有执念。

sentences.en: But he didn't know.
sentences.zh: 但他自己也不知道是哪种。

sentences.en: He was like, I'll know it when I see it.
sentences.zh: 他说：“我看到的时候自然就知道了。”

sentences.en: And so Phil was so excited to go out and buy, like, 12 mechanical pencils.
sentences.zh: 所以菲尔当时特别兴奋，跑去买了大概12支自动铅笔。

sentences.en: He made Phil's day.
sentences.zh: 这让菲尔开心了一整天。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好了。

sentences.zh: 准备好听第二个冷知识了吗？

sentences.en: I am.
sentences.zh: 准备好了。

sentences.en: Fast Fact No.
sentences.zh: 第二个冷知识是。

sentences.en: 2 is the email that we got from Miles McNutt, Angela.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，这是我们收到的一封来自迈尔斯·麦克纳特的邮件。

sentences.en: I loved this email.
sentences.zh: 我超爱这封邮件。

sentences.en: I have been waiting for us to share it.
sentences.zh: 我一直等着我们分享它呢。

sentences.en: Jenna, you have to tell everyone.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，你一定要告诉大家。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Our associate producer Ainsley was going through the office lady's mailbox, and she found this letter from Miles McNutt.
sentences.zh: 我们的助理制片人安斯利在整理“办公室女士”的邮箱时，发现了这封来自迈尔斯·麦克纳特的信。

sentences.en: And I'm going to read it.
sentences.zh: 我要读一下。

sentences.en: Ready?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: He says, greetings.
sentences.zh: 他说：问候各位。

sentences.en: My friends and followers were kind enough to alert me that my AV Club reviews have made it onto the podcast as the seventh season reaches its conclusion.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友和粉丝们好心提醒我，随着第七季接近尾声，我的AV Club剧评被搬上了播客。

sentences.en: And I want to thank you for bringing back fond memories of my time covering the show.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢你们唤起了我报道这部剧时的美好回忆。

sentences.en: I've become a media professor in the intervening period, and Rate My Professors has tagged me as a, quote, tough grader.
sentences.zh: 在这期间，我已经成为了一名媒体教授，而且在“评价我的教授”网站上，我被贴上了“评分严苛”的标签。

sentences.en: So let the record show that I am nothing if not consistent.
sentences.zh: 所以请记录在案，我这人一向如此，始终如一。

sentences.en: In the meantime, I look forward to hearing how Jenna felt about my take on the rest of the season,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我很期待听到珍娜对我剩余剧集评价的看法，

sentences.en: and highly recommend she stop reading my reviews in season eight for all of our sakes.
sentences.zh: 并且强烈建议她从第八季开始停止阅读我的剧评，为了我们大家好。

sentences.en: Well, now I can't wait.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在我迫不及待了。

sentences.en: Now I can't wait for you to read them.
sentences.zh: 现在我迫不及待想让你读那些剧评了。

sentences.en: Oh, well, believe me, I'm not stopping.
sentences.zh: 噢，好吧，相信我，我可没打算停下来。

sentences.en: But he said that we should reach out if we ever want to hear how he feels about the show.
sentences.zh: 但他说了，如果我们想听听他对这部剧的看法，随时可以联系他。

sentences.en: He said, you know, he has different feelings about the show in hindsight, having watched it still many years later rather than in real time.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，事后回看，在多年之后而不是当时实时观看，他对这部剧有了不同的感受。

sentences.en: And I thought that would be kind of fascinating.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那会非常引人入胜。

sentences.en: We have to reach out to him.

sentences.en: Oh, for sure.

sentences.en: Not so bad.

sentences.zh: 他说他期待继续报道这部剧，看看这一季会如何展开。

sentences.en: As for the incentive, he gave it a C.
sentences.zh: 至于《激励》那一集，他给了个C。

sentences.en: So maybe this is where we start to go downhill.

sentences.zh: 我们从没拿过F。

sentences.en: Never.
sentences.zh: 从来没有。

sentences.en: That I am certain of.

sentences.zh: 因为他简单直接。

sentences.en: What you see is what you get.
sentences.zh: 所见即所得。

sentences.en: And that mediocrity could also be why people fight for him.
sentences.zh: 而这种平庸可能也是人们为他争斗的原因。

sentences.en: There's something about an underdog that really inspires the unexceptional.
sentences.zh: 弱者身上总有一种特质，能真正激励那些平凡的人。

sentences.en: Such a funny line.
sentences.zh: 真是句有趣的台词。

sentences.en: It's so well written.
sentences.zh: 写得太好了。

sentences.en: Andy is going to peel off his bandage.
sentences.zh: 安迪要揭掉他的绷带了。

sentences.en: And guess what the group did?
sentences.zh: 你猜大家做了什么？

sentences.en: They got him a nard dog.
sentences.zh: 他们送了他一只“纳德狗”。

sentences.en: And it's so cute.
sentences.zh: 而且太可爱了。

sentences.en: It's his nickety name.
sentences.zh: 那是他的绰号。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: That was some amazing makeup work by Laverne and her team.
sentences.zh: 那是拉文和她的团队制作的非常棒的化妆效果。

sentences.en: Just really, really great.
sentences.zh: 真的，非常棒。

sentences.en: We got a really fun piece of fan mail about tattoos, Angela.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我们收到了一封关于纹身的非常有趣的粉丝来信。

sentences.en: It's from Allie B in Canton, Michigan, who says, hi, ladies.
sentences.zh: 来自密歇根州坎顿市的艾莉·B，她说，嗨，女士们。

sentences.en: I just wanted to pop on and say that this episode inspired me to have my own tattoo incentive in my sorority.
sentences.zh: 我只是想冒个泡说，这一集启发我在我的姐妹会里也搞了个纹身激励计划。

sentences.en: When I was the president of my sorority, there was this survey that our international headquarters required us to fill out every year.
sentences.zh: 当我担任姐妹会主席时，国际总部每年都要求我们填写一份调查问卷。

sentences.en: It was super long and ridiculous, but we had to have at least 85% of the chapter completed.
sentences.zh: 那份问卷超长而且很荒谬，但我们必须保证至少85%的成员完成。

sentences.en: This was something that my chapter had struggled with in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 这曾是我们分会过去一直很头疼的问题。

sentences.en: So I told them if we got 90% participation, because I'm an overachiever, I would let them pick a tattoo for me.
sentences.zh: 所以我告诉她们，如果我们能达到90%的参与率，因为我这人追求卓越，我就让她们选一个纹身纹在我身上。

sentences.en: Lo and behold, they did it.
sentences.zh: 你瞧，她们真的做到了。

sentences.en: And they were thankfully very kind with my design.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，她们在设计上对我还挺仁慈的。

sentences.en: It's one of my favorite tattoos I have, and it's made even better because it was inspired by an episode of The Office.
sentences.zh: 这是我最喜欢的纹身之一，而且因为它是受《办公室》某一集的启发，所以意义更特别。

sentences.en: What was the tattoo?
sentences.zh: 纹的是什么？

sentences.en: She didn't say.
sentences.zh: 她没说。

sentences.en: Just that the idea of creating a tattoo incentive was inspired by The Office.
sentences.zh: 只是说这种搞纹身激励的想法是受《办公室》启发的。

sentences.en: But I would love to know.
sentences.zh: 但我真的很想知道。

sentences.en: I am amazed by the different ways episodes of The Office inspire people.
sentences.zh: 《办公室》的剧集以各种不同的方式激励着人们，这让我感到惊讶。

sentences.en: I know, right?
sentences.zh: 可不是吗？

sentences.en: The final scene of this episode is a tag between Angela and Pam.
sentences.zh: 这一集的最后一幕是安吉拉和帕姆的彩蛋。

sentences.en: This is them going on their walk together since they're walking buddies.
sentences.zh: 这是她们一起去散步，因为她们是散步搭子。

sentences.en: Yes, I remember filming this scene, and I was quite happy to be out walking around.
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得拍摄这一幕，能出来走走我挺开心的。

sentences.en: It was a little tough for me when I was that pregnant to just like sit in an office chair all day.
sentences.zh: 我怀孕到那个程度时，整天坐在办公椅上对我来说确实有点吃力。

sentences.en: You know, your legs fall asleep, you get the sciatica, and the yada, yada, yada.
sentences.zh: 你知道，腿会发麻，还会坐骨神经痛什么的，诸如此类。

sentences.en: So I was thrilled for this storyline.
sentences.zh: 所以我对这个剧情线感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: I noticed that they had us walk on the backside of the warehouse, which was always shady in the afternoon and had a nice breeze.
sentences.zh: 我注意到他们让我们在仓库后面走，那里下午总是阴凉，还有阵阵微风。

sentences.en: And this was the hottest time of our summer, so I bet we were very appreciative to be in the shade with the breeze.
sentences.zh: 当时正值我们夏天最热的时候，所以我敢说我们非常庆幸能待在有风的阴凉处。

sentences.en: You know, in this scene, Angela says that she's having an ethical dilemma.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在这一幕里，安吉拉说她遇到了道德困境。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And she reveals that she has called social services on Pam because she has been having some herbal tea in mugs that had trace amounts of caffeine.
sentences.zh: 然后她透露说她向社会服务部门举报了帕姆，因为帕姆一直用杯子喝含有微量咖啡因的草本茶。

sentences.en: My favorite moment is, I mean, this is so ridiculous, when Pam's like, you know what, Angela, why don't you call?
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的时刻是——我是说，这太荒谬了——当帕姆说，你知道吗，安吉拉，你为什么不打个电话举报呢？

sentences.en: And she's like, I already did.
sentences.zh: 然后她说，我已经打过了。

sentences.en: Well, we had a letter from Anna B.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们收到了一封来自俄罗斯安娜·B的信。

sentences.en: in Russia, who had something very interesting to say about herbal tea and pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 她对草本茶和怀孕有一些非常有趣的见解。

sentences.en: Anna said, I had my baby in Finland, and the official guidelines here say that it's okay to have caffeine during pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 安娜说，我在芬兰生的孩子，这里的官方指南说怀孕期间摄入咖啡因是可以的。

sentences.en: You know, there's a certain caffeine intake, which you're not recommended to go over during the day, but one cup of coffee is okay.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每天有一个建议不要超过的咖啡因摄入量，但喝一杯咖啡是没问题的。

sentences.en: However, Angela did have a reason to report Pam because herbal tea goes against the Finnish guidelines.
sentences.zh: 不过，安吉拉举报帕姆确实有理由，因为草本茶违反了芬兰的指南。

sentences.en: You're not supposed to drink it at all while pregnant.
sentences.zh: 怀孕期间根本不应该喝它。

sentences.en: The reason is that herbal teas might contain unknown harmful elements, according to the Finnish guidelines for pregnancy care.
sentences.zh: 原因在于，根据芬兰的孕期护理指南，草本茶可能含有未知的有害成分。

sentences.en: Maybe Angela was reading up on some Finnish guidelines.
sentences.zh: 也许安吉拉当时正在研读某些芬兰指南。

sentences.en: Perhaps there was an article in that magazine that Pam never read that said something about it.
sentences.zh: 或许帕姆从未读过的那本杂志里有一篇文章提到了这件事。

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不得而知。

sentences.en: Pam is going to suggest that maybe they just keep their pregnancies separate, not pretend to be in it together.
sentences.zh: 帕姆打算建议她们以后各自处理怀孕的事，不要假装同甘共苦。

sentences.en: And they spread apart a few paces and continue to walk side by side.
sentences.zh: 于是她们拉开了几步距离，继续并排走着。

sentences.en: But now they don't talk.
sentences.zh: 但现在她们不再说话了。

sentences.en: And I think this is why Miles was disappointed, because this storyline started and stopped all in one episode.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是迈尔斯感到失望的原因，因为这条剧情线在同一集里开始又结束了。

sentences.en: And I would have loved to have seen more of the two of them together in their pregnancies.
sentences.zh: 我本来很想看到更多关于她们两人一起怀孕的互动。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: I just would have loved to have seen their dynamics some more.
sentences.zh: 我只是很想多看看她们之间的化学反应。

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: Well, that's it for this episode.
sentences.zh: 好了，本集内容就到这里。

sentences.en: I want to give a big thank you to Phil Shea for hopping on the phone with me to tell me all about that pyramid.
sentences.zh: 我要非常感谢菲尔·谢伊抽出时间跟我通电话，告诉我关于那个金字塔的一切。

sentences.en: And also Steve Burgess, who gave me all of those wonderful emails, those wonderfully polite emails between himself and standards and practices.
sentences.zh: 还有史蒂夫·伯吉斯，他给了我所有那些精彩的邮件，那些他与审查部门之间非常有礼貌的邮件。

sentences.en: And I think we have to thank Miles McNutt, too, Jenna, for writing us that awesome letter.
sentences.zh: 我想我们还得感谢迈尔斯·麦克纳特，珍娜，感谢他写给我们那封很棒的信。

sentences.en: And Miles, we're going to keep checking in.
sentences.zh: 迈尔斯，我们会持续关注的。

sentences.en: We are.
sentences.zh: 我们会关注的。

sentences.en: We're going to track it.
sentences.zh: 我们会追踪这件事。

sentences.en: Gosh, I hope you'd never give us an F.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我希望你永远别给我们打不及格。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Next week is Lotto.
sentences.zh: 下周是《彩票》那一集。

sentences.en: We will see you then.
sentences.zh: 到时候见。

sentences.en: See you then.
sentences.zh: 到时候见。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。
